name: Berklee General Scholarship (Berklee Valencia graduate)
amount_detail: "Amount varies, multiple awards". Berklee states over $1.5m in merit- and need-based scholarship funds for graduate applicants at the Valencia campus. Total of ALL Berklee awards to one student is capped: "the total amount of all Berklee scholarship awards cannot exceed 90 percent of the tuition". Exact typical award NOT FOUND on the page.
currency: USD (Berklee Valencia states graduate tuition and its fixed-sum awards in USD; wave 1 recorded tuition USD 50,430 + fees for 2026/27). Percentage awards are expressed as % of tuition.
covers: Tuition only. "scholarship awards may not be used to pay the tuition deposit or any other non-tuition-related costs"; award "divided equally into three parts and applied directly to each semester's tuition bill".
eligibility_verbatim: "Scholarship Eligibility All applicants are eligible to apply for available Berklee scholarships." / "Eligibility: All master's degree applicants" / "Awarded to outstanding applicants accepted to any master's degree program on the Valencia campus."
exclusion_clause_verbatim: No nationality or residency exclusion appears on the page. The only nationality-linked sentence is a US-specific add-on: "In addition to applying for a scholarship from Berklee, we encourage all U.S. citizens and permanent US residents to submit the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA)."
deadline_2027_intake: Scholarship deadline is tied to the admissions round, NOT to the intake date: "If you submit your program application for early action (November 1), the scholarship deadline is November 15. If you submit your program application for regular action (January 15), the scholarship deadline is February 1." For a September 2027 start that means programme application 1 Nov 2026 / scholarship 15 Nov 2026 (early), or programme application 15 Jan 2027 / scholarship 1 Feb 2027 (regular). Exact 2027-intake dates NOT YET PUBLISHED as such - dates quoted are the standing cycle text on the page.
tied_to_institution: Berklee College of Music Valencia campus ONLY - merit aid attached to admission. It cannot be applied for independently and cannot be taken to another school.
notes: NOT automatic in the loose sense: a SEPARATE scholarship application must be filed, but it is a single form that then considers you for every award. "In order to apply for a Berklee scholarship, students must submit the Berklee Graduate Scholarship Application by the deadline. The Berklee Graduate Scholarship Application will appear in the Next Steps section of your online portal once you submit your program application." "All applicants who apply for a scholarship will automatically be considered for all scholarships listed below, depending on eligibility." Decision timing: "Applicants receive a scholarship decision after acceptance into a master's degree program. Applicants not accepted to the program will not receive a scholarship decision." Both merit AND need are assessed: "awarded to candidates demonstrating the highest musical and/or academic merit together with financial need." Conditions attach: "Students who receive scholarships are required to meet a series of terms and conditions relating to attendance, academics, and conduct in order to keep their award during the academic year." Note the 90% cap is the effective MAXIMUM for any combination of Berklee awards. Relevant programmes for this candidate: MM Music Production, Technology and Innovation (MPTI); MA Global Entertainment and Music Business (GEMB); MM Scoring for Film, TV and Video Games.

name: Berklee Groove Scholarship
currency: % of tuition (tuition stated in USD by Berklee)
eligibility_verbatim: "Eligibility: MM in Contemporary Performance (Production Concentration) for applicants whose principal instruments are drums, bass, general rhythm section, traditional/folk/non-traditional"
exclusion_clause_verbatim: Not excluded by nationality - excluded by programme and instrument: the award exists only for the MM in Contemporary Performance (Production Concentration) and only for the listed principal instruments. It is not available on MPTI, GEMB or SFTV.
deadline_2027_intake: Same cycle as the general scholarship application: 15 Nov (early action) / 1 Feb (regular action). See berklee-val-general.
tied_to_institution: Berklee Valencia, MM Contemporary Performance (Production Concentration) only
notes: Recorded because it is the single largest percentage award at Berklee Valencia (90%) and is therefore the headline number often quoted - but it is NOT reachable from the music-technology or music-business masters this candidate is targeting. Verdict NO is programme/instrument-based, not nationality-based.

name: Berklee Valencia Diversity Scholarship
amount_detail: "Up to 50 percent of the tuition (the total amount of all Berklee scholarship awards cannot exceed 90 percent of the tuition)"; "Up to four awardees per academic year"
covers: Tuition. "The award works as an addition to their general scholarship (if applicable)"
eligibility_verbatim: "Eligibility Requirements: Demonstrated leadership or support for historically underrepresented or culturally diverse communities, including first-generation college students. Acceptance to one of the graduate programs at Berklee Valencia"
exclusion_clause_verbatim: No nationality exclusion stated. Conditionality is evidential, not legal: the applicant must be able to evidence leadership of or support for underrepresented/diverse communities. "Priority will go to students with demonstrated financial need".
deadline_2027_intake: "Application deadline: February 1" with "Awardees announced: March 25". For a Sept 2027 start that is 1 Feb 2027 (standing cycle text; 2027-specific dates not separately published on the page).
notes: This one requires an EXTRA submission beyond the scholarship form: "Eligible candidates should submit a short video (up to three minutes) or a written personal statement (maximum 500 words) ... To be considered for this scholarship, candidates must complete the Berklee Valencia scholarship form found in the Next Steps section of the application portal. The link to the video or essay must be sent to scholarshipsvalencia@berklee.edu by the deadline." Stackable with the general scholarship up to the 90% ceiling - so general + diversity is the realistic route to a large award on MPTI/GEMB.

name: Berklee Outstanding Women Scholarships with Mentorship (MPTI / GEMB / SFTV / Contemporary Performance)
amount_detail: "up to 70 percent of tuition fees, plus mentorship sessions" - one award per programme, four programmes
eligibility_verbatim: "Awarded to one gifted individual who supports the musicianship and leadership of women in the music industry and who is accepted to the MM in Music Production, Technology, and Innovation." (parallel wording for GEMB, SFTV and Contemporary Performance)
exclusion_clause_verbatim: No nationality exclusion. The page's own framing is "We strive to support musicianship and leadership of women in the music industry" - the award text says "one gifted individual who supports the musicianship and leadership of women", which is not literally worded as women-only, but the programme intent is clearly to support women. Treat as effectively restricted unless Berklee confirms otherwise; a human should ask admissions directly.
deadline_2027_intake: Same cycle: 15 Nov (early action) / 1 Feb (regular action).
notes: CONTRADICTION FLAGGED, not resolved: the award title and the section header are women-focused, but the literal award sentence describes someone 'who supports' women in the industry rather than someone who is a woman. Do not rely on the looser reading without written confirmation from scholarshipsvalencia@berklee.edu.

name: Berklee Alumni Scholarship / Berklee Global Partners Scholarship
eligibility_verbatim: Alumni: "Eligibility: Berklee alumni ... Awarded to an outstanding Berklee undergraduate alumnus/a". Global Partners: "Eligibility: Student, alumnus/a, or faculty from a Berklee Global Partner school"
exclusion_clause_verbatim: Excluded by prior affiliation, not nationality: the candidate is neither a Berklee undergraduate alumnus nor a student/alumnus/faculty member of a Berklee Global Partner school (SMU MedTech Tunisia is not one, so far as this sweep found - NOT VERIFIED against Berklee's partner list).
notes: Only worth re-checking if SMU/MedTech Tunisia turns out to appear on Berklee's Global Partners list - a human should check that list once. These are the two awards on the page stated as a fixed USD sum, which confirms Berklee Valencia denominates fixed awards in USD, not EUR.

name: Berklee CACSA - Palau de les Arts Scholarships
funder: Berklee / Ciutat de les Arts i les Ciencies (CACSA) + Fundacio Palau de les Arts
amount_detail: NOT FOUND on the page - "Scholarship funds are allocated based on artistic, academic, and professional accomplishments as well as the financial resources of the candidates." Terms are in a linked PDF: "Terms of the agreement - CACSA Scholarship 2026-2027".
eligibility_verbatim: "Berklee, in compliance with its agreement with the Ciutat de les Arts i les Ciencies (CACSA) dated July 1, 2020, has an annual scholarship program aimed at Valencian students who have been admitted to any of its master's degree programs."
exclusion_clause_verbatim: "aimed at Valencian students" - a Tunisian citizen with no prior Spanish residency is not a Valencian student. HARD EXCLUSION.
notes: Recorded so it is not re-discovered as a live option. This is the largest locally-funded Berklee Valencia scheme and it is closed to this candidate.
